title: Curtis Millen cuts loose from the past with “Break Out the Cutters”
htmlContent:
Curtis Millen's newest single, "Break Out the Cutters," was written on a train headed to Amsterdam with just a pen, some paper, and his racing thoughts. What began as a simple poem written during a moment of panic turned into a powerful song about finding freedom.

Millen felt the burden of past habits holding him back, so he poured his feelings onto the page, crafting a message about letting go of worries that no longer help him. Inspired by the soulful music of Gregory Porter, he turned his words into a song, even recording a voice note before the train reached its destination. "Break Out the Cutters" is a song that captures the journey of breaking free.

https://open.spotify.com/track/63LybvKTYN5XvLv0yVsWBw

With a sound that mixes deep emotions and a sense of hope, the track encourages listeners to face their past, let go of what weighs them down and step into something better. This song was created while traveling to inspire listeners to move forward. For anyone who has ever felt stuck in their own patterns, "Break Out the Cutters" is a call to action.
